items.title: Collective Mining Intersects Mineralization Beyond Guayabales Project Resource Boundary
items.summary: Collective Mining reported new assay results from its Guayabales Project in Colombia, confirming gold-silver mineralization outside the current mineral resource area.
items.content: Collective Mining has released new assay results from its Guayabales Project in Colombia, revealing gold-silver mineralization that extends beyond the project's current mineral resource boundary. The drilling results, which tested areas for potential future resource growth at the Apollo deposit, included significant intercepts such as 146.10 meters at 1.07 grams per tonne (g/t) gold equivalent, 107.85 meters at 1.07 g/t gold equivalent, and 49.80 meters at 1.81 g/t gold equivalent. These findings provide new data on the project's geological potential and support the company's ongoing efforts to expand its resource base through district-scale drilling.

items.title: Law Firms Initiate Investigations into Universal Technical Institute, Inc. Following Financial Results
items.summary: Law firms are investigating potential federal securities law violations by Universal Technical Institute, Inc. following the company's fiscal 2026 financial results and lower-than-expected fiscal 2027 guidance.
items.content: Following the announcement of its fourth quarter and fiscal year 2026 financial results on November 18, 2026, Universal Technical Institute, Inc. (UTI) has become the subject of investigations by law firms including Kirby McInerney LLP and SueWallSt. The investigations focus on whether the company or its senior management made materially false or misleading statements regarding regulatory and operational risks, as well as federal student-aid verification requirements. The company reported a 46.7% year-over-year decrease in full-year 2026 net income and provided fiscal 2027 diluted EPS guidance of $0.00 to $0.09, significantly lower than the $0.60 reported for fiscal 2026. Management attributed the outlook to approximately $35 million in planned growth-related investments. UTI shares declined approximately 8.5% following the release of these results.

items.title: Executive Vice President Ehsan Zargar Executes Significant Insider Sale of Spectrum Brands Holdings Shares
items.summary: Spectrum Brands Holdings, Inc. Executive Vice President Ehsan Zargar recently sold shares of the company, marking the largest insider sale observed in the past year.
items.content: Spectrum Brands Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: SPB) saw a notable insider transaction on November 21, 2026, as Executive Vice President Ehsan Zargar sold shares valued at approximately US$2.4 million. The shares were sold at an average price of US$86.45, representing a 24% reduction in the executive's total holdings. While the transaction is identified as the largest insider sale of the company's stock within the last year, market analysis suggests the move is not necessarily indicative of a major fundamental concern for the company. The sale occurred near the prevailing market price of approximately US$80.65.

items.title: LandBridge to Join Russell 3000 Index
items.summary: LandBridge has been selected to join the Russell 3000 Index as part of a broader rebalancing of energy sector stocks.
items.content: LandBridge has been named as one of the energy stocks set to join the Russell 3000 Index. This inclusion reflects the company's market position and is part of a scheduled rebalancing of the index. The Russell 3000 is a widely tracked benchmark that includes the 3,000 largest U.S. companies by market capitalization. Inclusion in the index typically increases visibility among institutional investors and may lead to increased trading volume as index-tracking funds adjust their holdings.

items.title: Porch Group COO Matthew Neagle Sells Shares Worth Over $1.1 Million
items.summary: Porch Group, Inc. Chief Operating Officer Matthew Neagle sold 56,250 shares of company stock in a transaction reported via an SEC Form 4 filing.
items.content: On November 13, 2026, Porch Group, Inc. Chief Operating Officer Matthew Neagle sold 56,250 shares of the company's common stock for a total value of $1,180,457. The transaction was executed pursuant to a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan that the executive had established on June 15, 2026. Following this sale, Neagle retains control over 1,680,506 common shares of the company, all of which are held directly. The sale was disclosed in a regulatory filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

items.title: Acuity Inc. Announces New Term Loan Facility and Amendment
items.summary: Acuity Inc. has filed SEC documentation regarding a new unsecured delayed draw term loan facility of up to $400 million and the maturity date for its term loan facility.

items.title: AMC Initiates AI-Powered Theater Programming Pilot in Europe
items.summary: AMC Entertainment is testing artificial intelligence to optimize theater programming and auditorium utilization across its European operations.
items.content: AMC Entertainment Holdings, Inc. has begun testing AI-powered theater programming within its European cinema network. The initiative aims to optimize auditorium utilization, reduce operational costs, and drive EBITDA growth by leveraging the company's existing operating leverage. This pilot program represents a strategic effort to integrate automation into its exhibition business model.

items.title: NextEra-Dominion Merger Cleared by DoJ Antitrust Division
items.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice Antitrust Division has cleared the proposed merger between NextEra Energy and Dominion Energy.
items.content: The U.S. Department of Justice (DoJ) Antitrust Division has officially cleared the acquisition of Dominion Energy by NextEra Energy. This regulatory approval marks a significant milestone in the merger process, removing a key hurdle for the transaction. The clearance follows a thorough investigation by the DoJ into the competitive implications of the deal. The companies are now expected to proceed with the remaining steps required to finalize the combination.

items.title: Wall Street Firms Update Ratings and Price Targets for TransMedics
items.summary: Multiple financial institutions, including JPMorgan, Baird, Stifel, Piper Sandler, and Canaccord Genuity, updated their investment ratings and price targets for TransMedics Group, Inc. on November 21, 2026.
items.content: On November 21, 2026, several Wall Street firms issued updated research notes regarding TransMedics Group, Inc. (TMDX). JPMorgan analyst Allen Gong maintained a Hold rating while lowering the price target from $149 to $85. Baird analyst David Rescott maintained a Buy rating and adjusted the price target from $122 to $117. Stifel analyst Thomas Stephan maintained a Hold rating and reduced the price target from $80 to $70. Piper Sandler analyst Matthew O'Brien maintained a Buy rating with a $100 price target, while Canaccord Genuity analyst William Plovanic maintained a Buy rating and increased the price target from $94 to $120.
